source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Errata to the [In the Shadow of Iron](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.brood-brothers-auxilia.in-the-shadow-of-iron) Stratagem (Brood Brothers Auxilia): its When and Effect sections use 8″ in place of 9″ for 2 distances:

- how close to a [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) marker an enemy unit must end its move
- how far, horizontally, the relocated marker must be from every enemy unit (more than 8″)

distanceReplacements.role: enemy unit ends a move within this distance of a Cult Ambush marker
relocated marker must be more than this distance horizontally from all enemy units
